Grandma's Simple Tomato Salad

Serves 4. Ready in 10 minutes.

This is the tomato salad my grandmother made every summer. It needs nothing more than ripe tomatoes, good olive oil, and flaky salt.

Ingredients

  • 4 ripe tomatoes, sliced
  • 2 tbsp olive oil
  • 1 tsp red wine vinegar
  • Flaky salt and pepper
  • A handful of fresh basil

Instructions

  1. Arrange the sliced tomatoes on a plate.
  2. Drizzle with olive oil and vinegar.
  3. Season with salt and pepper, scatter basil, and serve.
